en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a European city street scene. Prominently featured is a baroque church with an ornate tower, as well as grand 19th-century buildings lining a bustling street. Visible are pedestrians, horse-drawn carriages, and early automobiles. A flagpole with banners is positioned in the center. The title at the bottom reads: 'Graz. Herrengasse mit Stadtpfarr-Kirche'. Additional small print indicates the publisher and a date range (1914-15).
